inlines.v: DIGNIFIED, participle passive [See Dignify.] 1. Exalted; honored; invested with dignity; as the dignified clergy. 2. adjective Marked with dignity; noble; as dignified conduct, or manner. To the great astonishment of the Jews, the manners of Jesus are familiar, yet dignified
